Subject: Perchlytics pilot: post-call alignment & onramp checklist

Tom / Maya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a shared starting point for the pilot kickoff: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Primary pain: manual triage and slow model scoring across customer documents (current workflow ~4 FTEs / week).
- Business goal: reduce manual review time by 40% and surface high-confidence flags with <=3% false positives.
- Non-functional: strict data isolation and audit logs (HIPAA-ish requirements), predictable latency for 95th percentile requests.

Proposed pilot scope (what we discussed)
- Ingest: ~1M historical documents (PDFs / text) for model evaluation; sandbox queries from internal QA.
- Workloads: batched batch scoring + interactive assistant for reviewers (95th pctl latency target < 400ms).
- Success metrics: reduction in manual review time, precision@K for high-confidence flags, operational metrics (token cost, latency).

Immediate asks for kickoff (what we need from Perchlytics)
1) Sample dataset (5k document extract) + sample queries (anonymized)
2) Primary technical contact for infra/network (IP allowlist, firewall rules)
3) SSO / IdP details if you want SAML/SCIM for Redwood Console
4) Any non-disclosure / legal requirements — please attach the signed MA if available

Proposed timeline
- Week of May 24: environment provision + data handoff
- Week of May 31: prompt suite + evals defined (joint workshop)
- Weeks 2–5: evaluation runs, prompt tuning, telemetry integration
- Week 6: acceptance review and recommendations

Next steps I suggest
- Tom: send sample dataset and confirm infra contact (Maya?)
- Perchlytics: review attached pilot matrix (I attached a draft) and confirm that timeline works
- We'll prepare an onboarding checklist and invite a kickoff meeting for May 24 if ready

Attachments: perchlytics-pilot-matrix.xlsx (draft), pilot scope notes

Thanks — I'll follow up on logistics once I have the dataset link and infra contact.

—
Karthik Iyer

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful and accurate. Couple clarifications from our side and attached a short data requirements PDF: perchlytics-sample-data-reqs.pdf (PDF, 92KB).

Clarifications / constraints
- Our primary concern is PII: we can provide an anonymized sample of 5k documents. Full dataset will be available behind our VPC once contracts & firewall rules are in place.
- We need a dedicated capacity estimate; if you can provide a ballpark committed capacity price that helps internal approval.
- Timeline: May 24 start is fine, but we'll need 48–72 hours to sign the MA + get internal security clearance.

Pilot acceptance metrics (specifics)
- Manual review reduction target: 40% relative to baseline (measured by reviewer hours / week).
- Precision target for 'escalate' flag: >=85% on gold set.
- Observability: want token-level cost dashboard, 95th pctl latency heatmap, and audit logs exported daily.

Infra contact: Maya Brooks (maya.b@perchlytics.ai) — she'll coordinate network/IP allowlist and provide a service account for data transfer.

I'll attach our initial signed MA for reference (perchlytics-signed-ma.pdf) — note this is an internal draft; we will send the final Docusign link by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
